stem: In a circle with center $M$, chord $AB = {=L}$ cm and chord $CD = X + {=k}$ cm. Given that $CD$ is closer to the center than $AB$, find the least whole number value of $X$.
solution: $CD$ is closer to the center than $AB$, so $CD$ is longer: $X + {=k} > {=L}$.
The least whole number greater than {=lo} is {=lo + 1}.
